name: Minimal clean
when_to_use: modern design-led products; tech; everyday stationery
palette: off-white, warm grey, one accent from product
surfaces_preferred: matte paper, light plaster, pale oak, felt
styling_notes: generous negative space, few geometric props, tidy grid

name: Warm natural
surfaces_preferred: raw oak, linen, kraft paper, canvas, terrazzo
styling_notes: lived-in but tidy, organic props, dried botanicals
avoid: cold blue tones, chrome, glossy plastic

name: Luxe moody
when_to_use: premium pens; leather goods; gifting; brands priced high
palette: espresso, charcoal, deep green, brass, ivory
surfaces_preferred: dark walnut, leather, black marble, velvet, slate
styling_notes: rich textures, low-key but still soft light, gold or brass accents
avoid: bright pastels, plastic props, busy sets

name: Pastel soft
palette: blush, sage, powder blue, butter yellow, white
surfaces_preferred: coloured paper, pastel plaster, light linen
styling_notes: airy, tone-on-tone, fresh flowers or fruit accents
avoid: dark shadows, heavy wood, masculine dark props

name: Bold colour
when_to_use: youthful brands; kids; playful stationery; social campaigns
palette: one saturated backdrop (mustard, cobalt, coral) + white
styling_notes: single strong colour field, graphic composition, 1-3 props
avoid: more than one strong colour, muddy tones

name: Editorial travel
when_to_use: wallets; bags; travel and tech accessories; cameras
palette: stone, olive, navy, tan leather, concrete grey
surfaces_preferred: concrete, stone, travel desk, linen bedding, cafe table
styling_notes: story of a journey or workday, passport/map/coffee cues
